full_judgment: 3. The petitioners as plaintiffs instituted a suit for partition of their paternal ejmali properties being Title Suit No. 278 of 1983 in the 3rd Court of Subordinate Judge, Dhaka against all his co-sharers including opposite party No.1, who was shown as defendant No.8. The defendant No. 8 (opposite party No. 1) did not enter appearance. On 10.11.1983 the defendant Nos. 1-6 namely the mother and sisters of the petitioner and the opposite party No.1, the brother of the petitioners entered appearance. They effected a compromise and filed a solenama on 27.2.84. The final decree was drawn according to the solenama dated 1.4.84. On 4.5.84 opposite party No. 1 Nazmul Hassan filed a seperate suit being Title Suit No. 163 of 1984 for partition of ejmali properties impleading all the heirs of his father late Shamsul Haque and prayed for appointment of a Receiver. On 20.6.1984 the petitioner along with other defendants entered appearance. They filed a written objection on 25.4.1985 against the prayer of appointment of a Receiver stating, inter alia, that the earlier Title Suit No. 287 of 1983 between the parties had ended in compromise. A copy of the said petition was served upon the learned Advocate of the opposite party No.1 on 25.4.85. On 17.8.85 the opposite party No.1 filed an application under Order 9 rule 13 read with section 151 of the CPC being Miscellaneous Case No. 756 of 1985 for setting aside the ex parte decree dated 27.2.84 as against him in Title Suit No. 278 of 1983 on the ground that he did not receive any summons and he came to leam about the ex parte decree on 27.9.84 on receipt of notice in FMA Case No. 174 of 1984 preferred by the petitioners against the order dated 16.3.85 of appointment of a Receiver in Title Suit No. 163 of 1984. The opposite party Nos. 1-10 of this Miscellaneous Case resisted the application by filing written objection denying the allegation of non-service of summons upon the petitioners and pleading bar of limitation.
